text:
The constraints force one block and one ordering.

Gus is immediately after Hana, and Hana is before Finn with exactly one slot between them, so those three occupy Hana–Gus–Finn in a row. Cara–Ben is an adjacent pair that must sit entirely before that block, and Ben is at most two slots before Hana. Ivo is before Gus and at least three slots from Hana, so Ivo is at least three slots before Hana. Ann, Dev, Cara, Ben, and Ivo all have to precede Hana, so Hana starts at slot 7 or later. Finn two slots after Hana still fits on the board only if Hana is in 7.

The only placement that also satisfies Ann before Ben, Ann exactly one slot from Dev, Dev before both Ben and Hana, and Ben at least three slots from Ivo is slots 1–5 as Ann, Ivo, Dev, Cara, Ben. Slot 6 is the remaining person, Eve.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Ann","2":"Ivo","3":"Dev","4":"Cara","5":"Ben","6":"Eve","7":"Hana","8":"Gus","9":"Finn"}
CONFIDENCE: 95
